title: Rabbi Chanina bar Yosef

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.65b.19-21) it is related that he, Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba, and Rabbi Assi happened upon a certain inn. Rabbi Chanina bar Yosef said, "Let us rent," but Rabbi Assi said, "Let us not rent." Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said to them, "Let us rely on the words of the elder and rent." They came and asked Rabbi Yochanan, who said to them, "You did well to rent." Hyman refers to his Rabbi Chama bar Yosef entry, where he explains that Chama should be read here rather than Chanina.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Eruvin names Rabbi Chanina bar Yosef; Hyman proposes Chama. Rabbi Yochanan’s reply approving the rental begins on [the next folio](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.66a.1).
